title: How Developers Discuss Generative AI: A Longitudinal Study of the Visual Studio Code Community
abstract: arXiv:2609.04680v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generative AI tools such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, and coding agents have rapidly become part of everyday software development, yet little is known about how mainstream open source communities discuss them in practice. This paper presents a longitudinal analysis of generative-AI-related discussions in the Visual Studio Code (VS Code) GitHub repository, using 43,806 candidate issues created between January 2021 and June 2026. To improve corpus quality, we combined keyword retrieval with semantic relevance filtering, yielding a filtered corpus of 25,227 AI-related issues. We applied BERTopic to the retrieved corpus to identify discussion topics, using the filtered corpus for theme validation and a robustness re-clustering, and analyzed their evolution over time using monthly prevalence and Mann-Kendall trend tests. translated_title: 开发者如何讨论生成式AI：对Visual Studio Code社区的纵向研究
translated_abstract: GitHub Copilot、ChatGPT和编码智能体等生成式AI工具已迅速成为日常软件开发的一部分，然而关于主流开源社区在实践中如何讨论这些工具，我们知之甚少。本文对Visual Studio Code（VS Code）GitHub仓库中与生成式AI相关的讨论进行了纵向分析，使用了2021年1月至2026年6月间创建的43,806个候选议题。为提高语料库质量，我们将关键词检索与语义相关性过滤相结合，最终得到了由25,227个AI相关议题组成的过滤语料库。我们对检索到的语料库应用BERTopic来识别讨论主题，使用过滤后的语料库进行主题验证和稳健性重新聚类，并利用月度流行度和Mann-Kendall趋势检验分析这些主题随时间的演变。结果表明，开发者的讨论主要由关于AI辅助开发工具运行的实际问题所主导。
tldr: 该研究通过对VS Code社区25,227个AI相关议题的纵向分析，结合BERTopic主题建模与趋势检验，系统揭示了开发者讨论生成式AI工具的主题分布及其随时间的演变规律。
en_tdlr: This study systematically reveals the discussion topics and their temporal evolution regarding generative AI tools among developers through a longitudinal analysis of 25,227 AI-related issues in the VS Code community, combining BERTopic modeling with trend tests.
